chapter_mission: Nelani Dinn arrives at the asteroid; she has assembled enough evidence to accuse Jacen of consorting with a Sith; the confrontation is set.
chapter_turn: The book's moral argument made flesh — another Jedi, doing what Jacen would have done six months ago, walks through the door.

scene_plan.purpose: Nelani arrives at the asteroid with her investigation in hand; she states the case.
Jacen's reply; the fork-vision technique used once — he sees, in one future, Nelani alive and Luke dead at his hand.

exit_vector: Nelani standing in the asteroid's main chamber with her lightsaber drawn, Jacen across from her, Ben watching from the threshold.
notes: The longest Ch 32+ chapter (5773 words). Most of the chapter is Nelani's case — Allston lets her speak.
